item.title: 'Do you believe in miracles?' It's that time
item.description: The 'quad god,' cross-country superstar Jesse Diggins and skimo -- there's plenty to pay attention to at the Winter Olympics, writes Cloe Axelson.

item.title: What if the polio vaccine becomes optional?
item.description: The head of the CDC’s vaccine advisory panel recently said he thinks vaccines for polio and measles should be optional. A fact-check of the Trump administration’s latest moves against mass vaccination.

item.title: The stunning play that secured the Patriots' win over the Seahawks the last time they faced off in the Super Bowl
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks had a chance to win Super Bowl 49 against the New England Patriots in 2015. Trailing 28-24, Malcolm Butler intercepted Russell Wilson's throw, securing New England's victory.

item.title: 9-year-old Louis DiVito reports from the Super Bowl
item.description: 3rd grader Louis DiVito is this year's Super Bowl "kid reporter."

item.title: Pentagon says it's cutting ties with 'woke' Harvard, discontinuing military training, fellowships
item.description: The Pentagon says it will cut ties with Harvard University, ending military training, fellowships and certificate programs. This announcement comes amid an ongoing standoff between Harvard and the White House, which is demanding reforms at the Ivy League institution.

item.title: Trump ends Obama-era restrictions on commercial fishing in protected area off New England
item.description: President Donald Trump issued a proclamation reopening a huge swath of the Atlantic to commercial fishing. Trump says the move would reestablish fishing in Northeast Canyons and Seamounts Marine National Monument off the New England coast, a nearly 5,000-square-mile preserve east of Cape Cod that was created by former President Barack Obama.

item.title: How the Patriots could win the Super Bowl
item.description: ESPN Patriots Reporter Mike Reiss is covering the Super Bowl in Santa Clara. He joins WBUR's Weekend Edition to explain what the New England Patriots need to do to win their seventh Lombardi Trophy.

item.title: Drake Maye and the Patriots take on Sam Darnold and the Seahawks in Super Bowl 60
item.description: After two weeks of hype and anticipation, the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks will face off in Super Bowl 60 at Levi’s Stadium. Will Drake Maye and the Patriots capture their seventh Lombardi Trophy? Or will Sam Darnold and the Seahawks earn their second?

item.title: Seattle Seahawks win the second Super Bowl title in franchise history, beating the New England Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Patriots could break an NFL record with their seventh Super Bowl victory when they face the Seahawks at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara, Calif. But the Seahawks are gunning for their second Lombardi — and redemption.

item.title: Seahawks ride their 'Dark Side' defense to a Super Bowl title, pounding the Patriots 29-13
item.description: Devon Witherspoon, Derick Hall, Byron Murphy and the rest of Mike Macdonald’s ferocious unit pummeled Drake Maye, and the Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 29-13 on Sunday to win the franchise’s second Super Bowl.
